src_serialized.tooltip: Full cone angle in degrees (like Unity's real Light.spotAngle). Only used when Type is Spot.

src_serialized.name: enableSprite
src_serialized.header: Sprite — the light source's own look

src_serialized.name: glowSprite
src_serialized.tooltip: Leave empty to auto-generate a soft radial glow texture.

src_serialized.name: enableBeam
src_serialized.header: Beam — a visible glowing cone (Spot type only)

src_serialized.name: enableInfluence
src_serialized.header: Influence — tints nearby geometry; works with or without the sprite

src_serialized.name: influenceMode
src_serialized.tooltip:
UniformTint (default): a single flat colour swap for the WHOLE renderer via MaterialPropertyBlock — zero setup, works on ANY material, but a large surface tints uniformly regardless of where on it the light is actually nearest.

PerPixel: real per-fragment falloff via a shared global array (see FakeLightInclude.cginc) — only the geometry actually near the light is affected, like a real point light. Requires the material's shader to sample SampleFakeLights() (Toolkit/FakeLight/PerPixelReceiver already does).

src_serialized.name: influenceRescanInterval
src_serialized.tooltip: How often UniformTint mode re-scans for nearby renderers, in seconds — every-frame OverlapSphere is wasted work for a source that rarely moves. Not used in PerPixel mode.

src_members.sig: public static Mesh GenerateConeMesh(float length, float angleDegrees, int segments = 20)
src_members.name: GenerateConeMesh
src_members.comment: A cone mesh — apex at the origin (the light's own position), opening along LOCAL +Z (the light's forward direction) out to beamLength, with a radius set by the spot angle. Vertex colour alpha is 1 at the apex and 0 around the rim, so ordinary alpha interpolation across each triangle gives the whole cone a bright-near-the-source, fading-toward-the-edge gradient for free — no texture needed.
